card.name: Constants inside written math formulas
card.fires_on: A small number or minus sign that finishes a term in a written formula, such as the 2 in (age + 2) or the 1 in 5n-1. It appears in dosing and volume equations and in algebra.

modes.label: Constant added in a formula
modes.description: A digit that is added to or subtracted from a variable inside brackets in a calculation.
modes.example: The total bladder volume in children is calculated as [(age in years + <<2>>) x 30] mL;

modes.label: Algebra exponents and offsets
modes.description: A digit or minus sign in an algebraic expression, such as an exponent or a function argument.

modes.label: Dosing formula constants
modes.description: A digit in a clinical dosing formula, such as a weight or GFR term.
